counter_definitions.TCC_REQ_sum: requests processed by the TCC/L2 tag blocks
counter_definitions.TCP_TCC_READ_REQ_sum: read requests sent from TCP/L1 to TCC/L2
counter_definitions.TCP_TCC_WRITE_REQ_sum: write requests sent from TCP/L1 to TCC/L2
counter_definitions.TCP_TOTAL_CACHE_ACCESSES_sum: TCP/L1 cache-line tag accesses, including hits and misses

measurement_scope.aggregation: median of the final target dispatches within a profiler launch, then median across independent launches
measurement_scope.hardware: whole-kernel counters with all other operands fixed
measurement_scope.process_isolation: one rocprof invocation per mapping and launch

panel.selection: minimum full address-expression runs, then stable canonical word
